general_information.Syllabus Name: Character Development_Tạo hình nhân vật hoạt hình
general_information.Description: Students will work on specific character development skills necessary to work in the animation industry. Students will also be exposed to animating and cleaning up ‘on model’ from existing and created model sheets
general_information.StudentTasks: '- Attend at least 80% of contact hours in order to be accepted to the final examination - Actively participate in class activities - Fulfil tasks given by intructor after class - Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose - Read the textbook in advance - Access the course website (www.cms.fpt.edu.vn) for up-to-date information and material of the course, for online supports from teachers and other students and for practicing and assessment. - Computer with graphic design softwares including Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, Adobe After Effects, Adobe Premiere - Have color papers, Color Pencils, scissors... - Complete course's Portfolio with full contents of exercises and submit to the teacher 1 day after the course.
general_information.Tools: Tools: Learning tool requirements 1. School preparation: a) For each student - 01 light table b) To the studio: - Glass table - 01 projector 2. Students preparation: - Pencil, eraser, ruler, A3 paper. A4 - Computer with some version of photograph editing software such as Ps, Ai, Ae, Pr

description: Students will work on specific character development skills necessary to work in the animation industry. Students will also be exposed to animating and cleaning up ‘on model’ from existing and created model sheets

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Know the basics of Animation films.
Know the process of producing an Animation film.
Understand the role and responsibility of a cartoon artist in film making.
Understand how to build characters for an animated movie
Be able to draw a size comparison chart for characters.
Draw details of main-characters, sub-characters and coloring them.
Drawing action poses and facial expressions of characters

assessments.Grading Guide: - Participation grade will be given based on students' attendance, preparation, and quantity as well as quality of participation in classroom; quality of participation is demonstrated through asking relevant questions, making statements that add to and facilitate class discussion, and builds upon others’ comments. - Teacher give marks on student's student's Class participation and preparation only after the Portfolio submission.
1. Character shape and details: 5 poins 2. Color: 5 poins
1. Character turnaround sheets: 5 poins 2. Color: 5 poins
1. Collect resources: 4 points 2. Characters concepts: 3 points 3. Size comparison chart for characters :3 points
